svg.text: Black ink figures against rift haze. Only rift light, glowing accents, and status colors break the black. Cheap to make by code or by hand.
The same shapes as before, all in ink. A faint eye glint.
The rift shows more: the eye, the arrow, the runes, the sigil.
Next to the first look test
Left pair: ink outlines and color. Right pair: silhouettes.
The ground must be a mid value here, lighter than the figures.
About 100 px tall: shapes and glows read cleanly; nothing is lost to small detail.
